verdict.rationale: Synctera documents watchlist checks inside its KYC/KYB verification, which covers sanctions screening. It also offers enhanced due diligence submissions to support anti-money-laundering review, and a centralized operations platform shared with the bank partner. Case management appears only as an FAQ question, so it is not affirmative evidence, and the rest of the story is unevidenced. Missing for 10: transaction monitoring, documented case management for alerts, SAR-filing support, an explicit split of compliance duties between the fintech, Synctera and the bank, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the compliance workload is tooled — transaction monitoring, sanctions screening, case management for alerts, and SAR-filing support with a clear split of duties between me, the platform, and the bank

citations.quote: Synctera's verification solution runs identity and watchlist checks for personal and business customers and records the results as `verification` objects.
Enhanced due diligence (EDD) lets you submit additional information about high-risk customers, businesses, accounts, and transactions to support anti-money-laundering review and Customer Risk Rating.
Manage all operational workflows in a centralized platform with a set of tools that provide complete data visibility and seamless collaboration between you and your bank partner.
